name: 色卡选择器
description: 在工作面板里浏览 Tailwind / Material / 预设色板与渐变，从图片或剪贴板取色，用 AI 生成配色，检查对比度与色盲模拟，一键导出 CSS 变量、Tailwind 配置或 JSON，还能把配色装成 PI-Desktop 主题。

en.name: Color Picker
en.description: Browse Tailwind, Material and preset palettes plus gradients, pick colors out of images or the clipboard history, generate a scheme with AI, check harmony and text contrast, export CSS variables, a Tailwind theme or JSON, and install the palette as a PI-Desktop theme.
en.safetyNotes: Reads only the folder you pick and the host's clipboard history, and only while you are asking it to; AI calls send the color or style description you typed to the model the host owns, and credentials never reach the plugin. Installing a theme hands the host one sanitized CSS sheet that restyles the app shell; it is kept in the plugin's own settings and can be removed from the panel. No network access of its own, no file writes, no background service.

zh-CN.name: 色卡选择器
zh-CN.description: 在工作面板里浏览 Tailwind / Material / 预设色板与渐变，从图片或剪贴板取色，用 AI 生成配色，检查对比度与色盲模拟，一键导出 CSS 变量、Tailwind 配置或 JSON，还能把配色装成 PI-Desktop 主题。
zh-CN.safetyNotes: 只在你主动操作时读取你选择的文件夹与宿主剪贴板历史；AI 调用只把你输入的主色或风格描述交给宿主拥有的模型，凭据不会到达插件。安装主题会把一段经宿主消毒的 CSS 交给宿主来给应用外壳换肤，CSS 存在插件自己的设置里，随时可在面板中卸载。插件本身不访问网络、不写入文件、无常驻后台服务。

agentTools.name: suggest_palette
agentTools.description: Suggest a color palette (配色, 色板, 主题色) from a base color or a style description; returns named hex colors.

base.description: Base color in any CSS notation, e.g. #3b82f6 or oklch(62.3% 0.188 259.81). Optional.

style.description: Style description, e.g. "tech, dark, slightly purple". Optional.

count.description: How many colors to return. Defaults to 5.
